articleTitle: Shape Organization for Enhanced Design Optimization in Generative Systems Using Clustering Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: The current research in design space articulation tries to solve the problem that comes up because computer generative systems are becoming more complex, and there are more design options. This study makes a contribution to the existing body of research by introducing a technique for form clustering that utilizes K-medoids, a Machine Learning approach. The suggested method uses a clustering method to group design shapes that are similar and then pick a representative body for each cluster in a 2D-Grid Based representation. The efficacy of the process has been empirically validated by applying it to a novel test case and comparing it with other clustering evaluation methods. The accuracy of the results of this evaluation is about the same as that seen in an outside study. This gives us essential information about how to judge machine learning techniques.

articleTitle: Intelligent Housing System with Cryptographically Secure Ownership and Dynamic Price Bidding
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: The objective of this project is to provide an innovative strategy aimed at redefining the real estate and housing sector. The main objective of this project is to provide a platform that incorporates blockchain technology to ensure secure, transparent, and technologically sophisticated property ownership records that are resistant to tampering. Furthermore, it integrates a dynamic price bidding system, so altering the conventional methods of property acquisition and sale. The system provides cryptographic measures to secure the security of ownership, hence enhancing transparency and reducing susceptibility to fraudulent activities in property transactions. The use of a dynamic pricing mechanism enables property owners to modify prices in real-time, thereby aligning them with prevailing market demand and affording purchasers equitable pricing prospects. This project endeavors to enhance the efficiency of property transactions and mitigate the intricacies commonly associated with conventional real estate procedures through the utilization of smart contracts. The platform provides customers with interfaces that are designed to be easily navigable, as well as access to up-to-date market insights and sophisticated data analysis tools, enabling them to make well-informed decisions. This groundbreaking initiative possesses the capacity to revolutionize the real estate sector by cultivating trust, equity, and effectiveness, thereby ushering in a novel era of intelligent housing.

articleTitle: Polyp Segmentation Using UNet and ENet
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive study into the field of polyp segmentation using the novel use of two renowned deep learning architectures: U-Net and ENet. The paper, which focuses on the essential issue of identifying polyp areas in medical imaging, defines a distinct application of both U-Net and ENet algorithms, followed by a careful comparison of their various results. The study examines each algorithm’s unique strengths, limitations, and overall effectiveness and analyzing the segmentation data acquired from each method. Essentially, this study provides a thorough examination of polyp segmentation utilizing U-Net and ENet, opening the door for improved medical image analysis and informed decision-making in clinical terms.

articleTitle: Detection of Dental Caries Using NIR Images
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Dental caries is the most prevalent chronic disease, impacting 3.9 billion individuals worldwide. Medical specialists are required for the diagnosis of dental caries. Conventional methods such as bitewing, panoramic, and intraoral radiograph testing are used to detect dental caries. However, frequent and prolonged exposure to X-rays can harm internal organs. In order to overcome this difficulty, a portable, ionization-free near-infrared imaging approach is proposed. The detection of dental caries is automated using several deep-learning algorithms. The main objective of this work is to show how well a cascaded U-Net segmentation technique works in the image acquired from constructed NIR camera (950 nm). The cascaded U-Net model performed better at spotting dental caries with an accuracy of 98.7%.

articleTitle: Cyber Physical Social Systems for the Blind: A New Way to Connect
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: In the context of smart cities, a pioneering Cyber-Physical-Social System (CPSS) emerges as a transformative solution aimed at significantly improving the lives of individuals with visual impairments. This innovative system seamlessly integrates crucial elements: physical infrastructure, a sophisticated array of cutting-edge sensors, and an interactive social platform. The CPSS establishes real-time connections between blind users and sighted volunteers through an intuitive mobile application, delivering timely insights into their dynamic surroundings. The integration of adaptive physical components, such as smart streetlights, audio beacons, and tactile paving, cultivates an environment conducive to heightened awareness and effortless navigation. The holistic sensor network, encompassing cameras, Lidar sensors, motion, and proximity sensors, along with GPS trackers, contributes real-time data that contributes to a remarkable 30% reduction in navigation-related incidents. Furthermore, the dynamic social platform fosters collaborations between visually impaired users and their sighted counterparts, resulting in an impressive 25% increase in user-reported satisfaction and an overall enhanced quality of life. As the CPSS addresses challenges such as technological compatibility and privacy concerns, its projected trajectory indicates an attainable 40% increase in user engagement and a 20% decrease in dependence on external assistance. Collectively, the CPSS stands poised not only to revolutionize individual experiences but also to set a precedent for inclusivity and accessibility within the framework of smart urban environments.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Multi-Core Architectures
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: This study delves into the performance of smartphones, focusing on Android and iOS devices. Geekbench serves as a benchmarking tool to compare CPU scores across various Android devices, such as the Samsung S8 to the S23 Ultra, and iPhone models, from the iPhone 8 Plus to the iPhone 14 Pro Max. The research also includes personal testing on the Mi11x and Nokia 8 devices, involving CPU throttling tests and Geekbench GPU assessments using OpenCL and Vulkan frameworks. The results are presented in a graphical format, highlighting crucial metrics like battery drain, execution time, and synthetic scores, encompassing both single and multi-core performance aspects. The objective of this paper is twofold: 1.To illustrate the evolution of smartphone performance over recent years, drawing comparative insights between Android and iOS ecosystems. 2. To emphasize the importance of thermal and battery efficiency through dedicated tests on the Mi11x and Nokia 8 devices. This study serves as a valuable guide for consumers seeking to make informed smartphone purchases, unravelling the complexities of performance metrics and empowering them to choose devices that align with their specific needs and preferences.

articleTitle: Prediction of Chronic Kidney Disease with Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Good health and well-being is one of the goal of Sustainable Development. It specifically recognizes the growing concern posed by non-communicable diseases and strives to reduce premature deaths caused by these diseases by one-third by the year 2030. Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) is a prominent non-communicable illness that substantially impacts the wellbeing of people worldwide, affecting around 10-15% of the global population and resulting in significant morbidity and mortality.In order to address the health complications related to CKD, which include hypertension, anemia, mineral bone disorder, poor nutrition, acid-base imbalances, and neurological problems, it is essential to intervene promptly with appropriate medications and accurately identify the stages of CKD. Several research studies have utilized machine learning techniques to detect CKD at an early stage, with a focus on early detection rather than precise stage prediction. Both binary and multiple classifications have been employed in these studies, utilizing the ANN algorithm as the predictive model. The study utilized feature selection methods including analysis of variance and recursive feature removal combined with cross-validation. The model’s performance was assessed through tenfold cross-validation, and the results of the experiments showcased the efficiency of ANN algorithm. With the best performance indicators, a total of four distinct machine learning-based classifiers—Decision Tree, K-nearest neighbour, Logistic regression, and Random Forest—have been studied. ANN achieved 0.983 accuracy, 0.98 precision, 1.0 recall, and 0.99 F1score.

articleTitle: TNU-Net: Water Body Segmentation based on the Transformer Network with U-Net Model
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Satellite imagery is being increasingly examined using deep learning techniques for the purpose of remote sensing applications, particularly in the realm of water body detection. The identification and analysis of rivers, lakes, and reservoirs through segmentation has become possible, thereby enabling the examination of their statistical data. In times of crises such as floods and alterations in river courses, the use of real-time water body detection through remote sensing proves to be immensely beneficial. However, achieving a highly accurate segmentation of water bodies poses a significant challenge, primarily due to the requirement of high-resolution multichannel satellite images. Most of the existing methods in literature rely on satellite data obtained from multi-band satellites to extract water bodies. In contrast, the present study focuses on the segmentation of water body regions using relatively low-resolution RGB images without the utilization of additional multi-spectral channels. To address this issue, a novel approach is proposed, wherein a customized U-Net model equipped with a sequence of transformer networks is employed for segmentation. The proposed model not only incorporates a selection of satellite imagery, but also utilizes a customized preprocessing pipeline and a novel CNN segmentation architecture that integrates various boosting modules, including attention units, deep supervision, and residual blocks. In order to evaluate the overall performance of the proposed model, it is tested against a publicly available satellite dataset, and the results are assessed against standard benchmark metrics. It achieved 93% precision, 95% sensitivity, 92% Dice score, 95% specificity and 96% accuracy. The proposed architecture outperforms even the most high-performing baseline.The segmentation results obtained demonstrate a notable enhancement in performance when compared to the state-of-the-art approaches employed for the segmentation of water bodies from low-resolution satellite imagery.

articleTitle: Feature Analysis and Automatic Word Segmentation of Natural Language Processing Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Natural Language Processing (NLP) based automatic paper evaluation using ensemble deep learning algorithms involves leveraging advanced machine learning techniques to assess and evaluate academic papers automatically. Ensemble techniques combine the predictions of various kinds of deep learning models to improve overall performance and robustness. The proposed method includes feature extraction, segmentation and classification process. The feature extraction is done using multi modal neural network. This helps the features to convert into same modal features from different modes. Then word segmentation process is carried using Recurrent Neural Network of Long Short Term Memory with Conditional Random Field (RNN-LSTM-CRF) and Gated Recurrent Unit with Conditional Random Field (RNN-GRU-CRF). Simulation results prove the RNN-GRUCRF provides better accuracy of word processing compared to the existing models.

articleTitle: A Smart and Systematic Ration Grocery and Liquid Materials Vending Machine using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: A ration card is essential for every household, since it may be used as evidence of address, for obtaining a gas connection, for verifying family membership, and for many other reasons. Ration card holders may purchase at designated stores for staples including rice, wheat, coconut oil, and more. The current ration system has two flaws: the measurement of the product may be incorrect due to human errors, and if the materials are not bought until the close of a given month, proportion retailers are going to market it to other people at higher prices with no the knowledge of the customers or the government. The purpose of this article is to provide an automated filling machine that can fill all of a customer’s ordered items at once. The load-cell feedback used in this equipment ensures precision in weight readings and protects clients from being duped. Ration dispensing machines are the subject of this research. Conventional ration systems for distribution waste a lot of money, so this automated machine was designed to do away with that. Instead of using paper ration cards, this method uses RFID tags as electronic rations. The customer must use his special card rather than a standard ration card while making purchases from the dealer. The current Ration store system has several flaws. They are slow to process data. Because of a lack of workers, filling and packaging orders takes an inordinate amount of time. Many ration vendors even under-weigh the goods despite the fact that the consumer has specified a specific weight. The purpose of this article is to provide an automated filling machine that can fill all of a customer’s ordered items at once. The load-cell feedback used in this equipment ensures precision in weight readings and protects clients from being duped.

articleTitle: Data Stream Classification Framework for Data Streams using Dynamic Ensemble Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: With the progressive advancement in the area of information technology, an huge amount of data is produced and transmitted every second in the real world. To address imbalanced data with idea drift for data streams, a novel framework for data stream classification is proposed. The class imbalance problem in data stream is handled using the proposed Adaptive Synthetic Oversampling (ASYNO) algorithm and if the concept drift occurs in data streams, then there is a possibility of sudden decrease in the balanced accuracy score. A novel dynamic classification framework based on the Dynamic Ensemble Selection (DES) was proposed in order to address the deteriorated balanced accuracy score and geometric mean in the incoming data stream. The classifiers which classify minimum one example from the competence region is chosen by KNORA-U. The number of votes obtained from each classifier is equal to the number of instances in its competence region for which, it predicts the target class. In case to arrive at the last ensemble decisionmaking, the votes received by each dynamically selected base classifiers are merged using majority voting. The proposed framework using DES, provides high balanced accuracy of 98.4% and geometric mean of 99.4% when compared to existing methods used for balancing the classes and for handling concept drift in data streams.

articleTitle: Multi-Lingual Sentiment Analysis of Urdu and English Tweets Using RNN with Bidirectional LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: In this research paper, we introduce a cross-lingual sentiment analysis model designed to evaluate sentiments expressed in tweets associated with Pakistan’s political parties, across three languages: Urdu, transliterated Urdu, and English. Our model leverages a recurrent neural network (RNN) featuring a bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) architecture. Demonstrating remarkable proficiency, our model achieved an impressive accuracy rate of 95.64% on the test dataset, surpassing the performance of two other prominent cross-lingual sentiment analysis models, namely mBERT and RoBERTa. This study’s outcomes underscore the effectiveness of our proposed RNN-BiLSTM model for cross-lingual sentiment analysis. The model’s application extends to sentiment assessment of tweets concerning Pakistan’s political landscape, irrespective of language, be it Urdu, transliterated Urdu, or English. This analytical tool holds substantial potential for enhancing our comprehension of public sentiment and tracking evolving political trends within Pakistan.

articleTitle: Gesture-Driven Virtual Mouse with a Voice Assistant
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Hand gesture recognition plays a pivotal role in facilitating human-computer interactions. The system utilises OpenCV to perform real-time hand tracking and gesture recognition, enabling cursor movement control. Along with a novel Voice command detection by the microphone activates various functions, including clicking actions, launching/stopping gesture recognition, Google searching, finding locations on maps, file navigation, and obtaining the current date/time. The system processes the video stream to segment the hand region. It recognises gestures through contour analysis, translating them into mouse controls. By combining hand gesture recognition and speech recognition, the system enables intuitive hands-free control of the mouse cursor and access to additional functions through voice. The hand region is isolated by applying colour segmentation in the HSV (Hue, Saturation, Value) colour space. The contour is detected to track hand shape and gestures. Structural analysis of the contour and convex hull enables gesture recognition. This virtual mouse system enables handsfree computer control, improving accessibility. By eliminating the need for a physical mouse device, it provides a more convenient and intuitive user experience. The proposed virtual mouse system eliminates the necessity for a physical mouse device, allowing hands-free control. This advances human-computer interaction technology by providing a more accessible and convenient interaction method.

articleTitle: An automated effective communication system in a VR based environment for hearing impaired
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: In this article, a live speech-to-text generation system has been introduced through automatic speech recognition that will display the caption of the person’s speech to the user and the emotion/intent with which the speaker is speaking. The dataset used for emotional analysis is the RAVDESS (Ryerson Audio-Visual Database of Emotional Speech and Song) dataset. To identify the speaker's emotion, the audio features MFCC(Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients), Mel Spectrogram, and Chroma are extracted. Google's audio recognition module is used for speech-to-text conversion. The emotional analysis of the speech is done through an MLP (Multi-Layer Perceptron) classifier to classify the audio under 4 labels: "Angry", "Sad", "Neutral", and "Happy". The model is evaluated on audio samples from the dataset with basic emotions. The experimental results exhibits reasonable classification rate for emotional difference and the system is validated successfully using the Virtual Reality (VR) based environment.

articleTitle: Cloud based Medicine Scheduler
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: The paper aims to provide solution to the scheduling and managing of wide range of tasks related to the field of business, education, medical, transportation, etc. The primary focus would be on medical service which will basically involve collecting health data and pre-planning of medical resources for seasonal and emergency cases. The research focuses to automate the idea of existing, human intensive way of medicine scheduling and intake by patients in hospital/people with ailments. The paper provides detailed insight for the solution to this problem along with handling this sensitive data for analysis to provide timely attention to the medical needs of the patient and future unforeseen medical/business critical planning. The solution also targets an environment with minimal human and mobile device interaction for the end-user (here, patients) so as to curb the engagement of humans with high radio frequency radiation serving devices.

articleTitle: Utilizing Convolutional Neural Networks for Object Recognition with Image Filtering and Edge Detection in Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: The optimal technique for object detection directly in the compressed domain of a video sequence or an image is presented in this study, we delve into the application of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for object recognition, employing image filtering and edge detection techniques within the framework of deep learning. The paper leverages the power of CNNs to automatically learn and extract essential features from images, enabling effective object recognition. We explore the significance of image filtering and edge detection as preprocessing steps to enhance feature extraction, leading to improved classification accuracy. Through comprehensive experiments and analyses, we demonstrate the efficacy of our approach in various real-world scenarios, highlighting the potential for CNNs to play a pivotal role in advancing object recognition technology. This paper offers valuable insights into the synergy between CNNs and image processing techniques, with promising implications for diverse applications, including computer vision, robotics, and autonomous systems.

articleTitle: Cultivating Precision: A Multi-Layer Perceptron Approach for Accurate Classification of Maize Rust Disease Intensity in Precision Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Corn rust disease, which is induced by diverse fungal infections, presents a substantial peril to global food security since it impacts a fundamental crop that serves as a mainstay for many populations worldwide. This study aims to tackle the difficulties associated with conventional manual assessment techniques for measuring the intensity of maize rust disease. It proposes a systematic methodology that harnesses the power of deep learning. The research utilizes a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) model, employing a well-selected dataset to attain a noteworthy overall accuracy of 94.87%. The architecture of the MLP demonstrates proficiency in catching intricate patterns that are linked to varying levels of illness severity. The findings, as demonstrated by a detailed performance parameter table and confusion matrix, showcase the model's accuracy in detecting differences in disease severity. The suggested MLP has both superior accuracy and computational efficiency when compared to state-of-the-art approaches, as highlighted by the comparative study. In addition to its direct relevance to the management of maize rust disease, this study makes a valuable contribution to the wider field of precision agriculture. It presents scalable and efficient approaches that can be applied to tackle significant issues in global food security.

articleTitle: A Novel Fleet Management System in Underground Coal Mines using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Currently, a variety of areas use fleet management systems to organize mobility and delivery services. One of the most important technologies for subterranean fleet management is optimal path planning. Due to the intricate nature of both the drift environment and the vehicle’s structure, some modifications are necessary to accommodate the unique requirements of underground mining. This study suggests leveraging the Internet of Things (IoT) to design a fleet management system for underground coal mines. Optimal path planning is one of the key technologies for underground fleet management. Thus, IoT gives the efficient solution for finding the optimal path in underground coal mines. Moreover, the Voronoi diagram approach and its associated scenarios are the basis of the optimal path planning method, which is based on an upgraded A* (A-Star) algorithm for path planning for underground vehicles. The results are analyzed in terms of length of the path and number of examined cells for various existing algorithms along with the proposed algorithms.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Accuracy in Classifying Rice Seed Varieties using Novel Random Forest Algorithm Compared with Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: In agriculture, categorizing rice seed varieties presents a formidable challenge, particularly when considering their implications for production and marketing. Rice, a fundamental dietary staple, holds substantial importance in sustaining human food resources. A multitude of rice seed varieties have been grown in various regions across the world. Accurately classifying those rice seed varieties is a formidable task due to the striking visual similarities in color, shape, and texture among seeds of different varieties. This paper employs machine vision and machine learning techniques to create a swift method for detecting and categorizing rice seeds according to their variety and purity levels. The objective of our research is to perform classification of rice seed varieties in a fast and efficient manner that can be used by farmers for cultivation. A vision-based computer system was meticulously crafted to identify four distinct rice seed varieties, namely Andhra Ponni, Ko50, IR20, and Atchaya Ponni. This system harnessed the power of 23 distinct features, comprising 12 morphological features, 8 textural features, and 3 color features, for accurate classification and analysis. Then the complete dataset is created using the calculations of the above stated features obtained from the images. The created dataset is tested with classification algorithms such as Novel Random Forest and Support Vector Machine, out of which the Random Forest algorithm gives 95.12% of accuracy. The classification results effectively meet the requirements and expectations of both producers and consumers.

articleTitle: Enhancing Online Education Efficacy: A Multifaceted Analysis and Recommendation System for Online Courses
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: In today’s tech-driven world, education has undergone significant changes in schools and colleges worldwide. One of the latest trends in the education sector is online learning. This approach allows students to study over the internet, offering them flexibility and convenience. Online learning has proven to be effective in enhancing students’ performance and skills. However, selecting the right online courses can be a challenge for aspiring students. They need to consider various factors to ensure their chosen courses align with their goals. To address this challenge, we propose using data from popular online course platforms like Coursera and Udemy. By analyzing the course statistics available on these platforms, we aim to develop a recommendation system. This system will help students make informed choices by suggesting courses that match their interests and needs. Our study aims to gather and present course data from Coursera and Udemy and build a Course Recommendation algorithm to provide clear guidance for course selection. This will ultimately lead to an improved learning experience for students in the online education landscape.

articleTitle: ATNSCUNet: Adaptive Transformer Network based Sub-Convolutional U-Net for Single channel Speech Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Recent advancements in deep learning-based speech enhancement models have extensively used attention mechanisms. Attention mechanisms-based models achieve state-of-the-art methods by demonstrating their effectiveness. This paper proposes a adaptive transformer network based on sub-convolutional U-Net (ATNSCUNet) for speech enhancement. To overcome the long-dependency problem in sequence modelling networks, we employ a adaptive transformer network (ATN) between the sub-convolutional U-Net encoder and decoder instead of temporal convolutional networks and recurrent neural networks. ATN consists of a adaptive time-frequency attention (ATFA) module made up with Multi-head self attention and Gated recurrent unit. Together, the multiple ATFA modules create an "attention-inattention" structure based on adaptive attention weights. ATFA effectively captures time-frequency dependencies, and aggregates global contextual information. Additionally, to overcome the less receptive area problems in the feature learning process, we utilize the sub-convolutional U-Net (SCUNet) model. SCUNet is a convolutional encoder-decoder model that uses differentsized kernels to produce features at various scales. The proposed ATNSCUNet model outperforms several state-of-the-art methods based on experimental results.

articleTitle: Optimizing Metro Station Placement in Urban Planning Using Quantum Annealing
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: In this research paper, we employ D-Wave’s quantum annealer to address the NP-hard problem of optimizing new metro station locations while considering both points of interest and existing stations. By formulating the problem as Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) and Binary Quadratic Model (BQM), our approach harnesses the power of quantum computing to yield superior solutions compared to classical methods. This research has the potential to revolutionize urban transportation planning by efficiently balancing accessibility to points of interest and minimizing congestion around existing stations, offering a compelling solution to a complex urban development challenge. Notably, we emphasize the NP-hard nature of this problem, underlining its computational complexity and the significance of our quantum computing approach.

articleTitle: Automated Mango Rust Severity Classification: A CNN-SVM Ensemble Approach for Accurate and Granular Disease Assessment in Mango Cultivation
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: A major risk to mango production worldwide is mango rust, which is caused by the fungus Puccinia kuehnii and reduces both yield and quality of fruit. By combining a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) with a Support Vector Machine (SVM) ensemble model, this study presents a novel method for disease severity categorization. After collecting and annotating photos of mango rust-infected leaves with severity levels, a comprehensive dataset was created and enhanced. Using the feature vectors created by the CNN, the SVM was able to classify the severity levels of the photos. Overall, the suggested model was able to differentiate between five severity classifications with a success rate of 93.23%. Particular competence in identifying degrees of mild and severe illness was shown by the results. Both the field of automated disease assessment in mango production and the larger conversation about the ethical use of machine learning in farming are advanced by this study. Improving model interpretability, exploring ways to optimise transfer learning processes, and tackling ethical concerns related to data usage are all areas that could benefit from more research. A more robust and sustainable agricultural sector, one that can adapt to new plant diseases, is within reach, thanks to this research.

articleTitle: Advanced Multi-Scale Classification of Onion Smut Disease Using a Hybrid CNN-RF Ensemble Model for Precision Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: The production of onions is confronted with a notable challenge in the form of onion smut disease, which is caused by the fungal pathogen Urocystis cepulae. This disease has the potential to cause considerable reductions in crop productivity. This study presents a novel approach for accurately categorizing the levels of onion smut severity scales. The proposed method combines a hybrid Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Random Forest (RF) ensemble model. The dataset, which has been carefully annotated to encompass a wide range of disease scales, is subjected to preprocessing and augmentation techniques in order to improve the model’s capacity for generalization. The integrated CNN and RF model has a high level of accuracy, reaching 95.66%, as observed throughout a thorough evaluation process. The suggested technique demonstrates greater performance compared to baseline models, specifically in its ability to accurately capture the nuanced changes in onion smut severity. The utilization of confusion matrices in visualizing data enhances the interpretability of the information, hence facilitating a more thorough comprehension of the model’s capabilities and areas for future improvement. While commemorating these achievements, the study notes the obstacles associated with wider applicability and proposes future avenues for research. This study makes a significant contribution to the integration of computer vision and agricultural science by introducing a realistic and economical solution for accurately classifying onion smut scales in real-world agricultural settings.

articleTitle: Predicting and Evaluating Train Occupancy in Belgium using Weather Data by developing Ensemble Stacking Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: This research aims to predict train occupancy of Belgian trains by utilizing the Belgium trains dataset and Antwerp city weather dataset. The goal is to optimize train schedules and improve the overall efficiency of the Belgian train transportation system. Leveraging historical data and weather conditions, a predictive model, particularly the Stacking Classifier 1, was employed to accurately forecast train occupancy. The integration of weather data in the model proved crucial for making informed decisions in resource planning and train schedule optimization. By enhancing predictions and efficiency, this project has the potential to significantly enhance passenger experience, reduce costs, and minimize environmental impact in the Belgian railway system.

articleTitle: Development of a Mobile App to Detect Counterfeit Currency using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Counterfeit poses a serious threat to financial institutions and the global economy. This work introduces machine learning techniques that use image processing, pattern recognition, and classification algorithms to accurately identify false positives. These studies are based on analysis of real banknotes, their security features and counterfeiting techniques. Images of real and fake invoices are carefully recorded to create robust data for training and testing learning models such as neural networks (CNN). Image processing techniques such as edge detection and feature extraction improve the model's detection capabilities. The development model, evaluated in terms of efficiency, is integrated into a user-friendly interface and accepts cash register images as input. This solution aims to contribute to continuous efforts to combat fraud, providing a clear and effective way to protect financial institutions and increase business security.

articleTitle: A Quantifiable Detection of voids/Pores and Cracks in Scanning Electron Microscopic images using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Recently, Image Processing and analysis is an important in all fields such as science, mechanical and medical field. SEM (Scanning Electron Microscopic) read images and extracts the useful information from the samples. The mechanical expert’s analysis the samples in qualitative. They are missing many pores/voids and cracks in the SEM images so the strength of material is not identified properly. By taking this issue, a quantitative analysis is done by so can identify exact pores and cracks present in the SEM image. Here applied machine learning algorithm such as classification and regression algorithm. It classifies the images in the form of RGB where masking techniques is applied. It can analyse the edges of cracks, pores/voids in SEM image. Linear regression predicts the material strength as strong and weak. Here we used improvised classification and regression algorithm. It helps to predict material strength at initial stage. Hence this algorithm is works for both metal and non-metal Images.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques for Addressing Class Imbalance Issues in Network Intrusion Detection Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Nowadays, a lot of information is shared between various connecting devices due to the quick development of internet technologies and the growing reliance on online services. Security systems are one of the most important scientific topics in today’s computer network, so data should be transmitted safely between connected devices. The intrusion detection system is crucial for network security because it can identify and stop malicious activities. IDS still has trouble identifying novel intrusions due to data imbalance problems and a high false alarm rate. Many different methods have been applied to either prevent or detect intrusions. We discussed several research problems as well as potential future directions for NIDS. This study investigates ML-based and DL-based intrusion detection strategies and dataset selection.

articleTitle: Advancing Rice Blast Disease Classification Through CNN-LSTM Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Magnaporthe oryzae, a fungus, causes rice blast disease, which threatens world rice production and, by extension, the food security of a large number of people. In light of the critical need for rapid and precise illness identification, this study presents a new method for multi-classification based on the five stages of rice blast disease namely multiclass (MC) 1 to MC 5 using a hybrid model of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long Short-Term Memories (LSTM). An outstanding overall accuracy of 95.92% in differentiating between various illness phases was attained by the model, which was developed to harness both spatial and temporal information. After being tested extensively on a wide range of datasets, the model proved to be quite good at generalizing to new environments, which bodes well for its practical use in farming. It appears that the model can better reflect the complex course of rice blast disease when CNN and LSTMs are combined in a hybrid architecture. This research adds to the field of plant pathology by developing a reliable automated method for disease categorization, even if it can be difficult to differentiate between intermediate phases. In order to ensure the long-term viability of rice production around the world, the results highlight the significance of using cuttingedge technology for proactive disease management.

articleTitle: Utilization of Deep Learning Techniques in an Innovative Approach for Covid-19 Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: The global health catastrophe brought on by the COVID-19 pandemic is without parallel. Researchers are concerned about finding ways to stop the pandemic outbreak and save lives as the corona virus continues to spread. The challenges brought on by pandemics have been addressed in part by the approach of an artificial intelligence (AI). We create a deep learning method in this work to identify COVID-19 and extract features from chest X-ray images. An improved dataset was developed by combining common chest x-ray images from multiple public sources with COVID-19 image sources; ResNet50, InceptionV3, and VGG16 were adjusted on this dataset. To create an artificially substantial quantity of chest X-rays, we used data augmentation methods such noise, random spin at an angle between 10 and 10 degrees, and flips from horizontal to vertical. Positive experimental results were obtained: Resnet50 earned 97.2%, InceptionV3 earned 98.1%, and VGG16 achieved 98.3%. These recommended models correctly identified chest X-ray images as Normal or COVID-19. The outcomes reveal efficient and straightforward COVID-19 identification techniques, demonstrating the effectiveness of transfer learning. This makes it possible to accurately automate the procedure for examining X-ray images, and it may also be used if supplies and RT-PCR assays are in short supply.

articleTitle: A Framework to Boost Team Effectiveness Through AI based Personality and Skill-Based Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Choosing the right team members in a project is important as it determines how successful they can get together and productivity of the team as choosing the wrong ones can lead to delays, lack of motivation and other scenarios. One of the important factors that help determine good team members would be their alignment with the project’s goals and needs. However, these do not entirely help understand a candidate’s personality, which is key to their performance and productivity. This research focuses on implementing Deep Learning to extract the "Big 5 Ocean Traits" of user behavior from carefully designed questions and create groups based on OCEAN trait scores after shortlisting based on their skills. BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) was used to determine the personality scores of the person using the answers that they provided for the given questions. An optimized algorithm was developed to form teams based on their OCEAN trait score that will improve the overall efficiency

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Multicore Architectures
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: This study comprehensively compares multicore architectures to meet the growing demand for computing power and energy efficiency. In this study the performance dynamics of three prominent architectures X86, ARM and RISC-V is investigated using benchmark applications: scientific simulations, parallel rendering and database loads. This study evaluates the performance of these architecture in terms of efficiency, adaptability, and optimization strengths various computing scenarios under heavy workloads and the results are presented.

articleTitle: A Detailed Examination of Deep Learning Models for Detection of Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder(ADHD)
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: the neurodevelopmental disorder ADHD (Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder) has an impact on a person's brain function and it is also highly heritable. It affects many people's daily life and they are unaware that they are affected. Evidence from twin and family research indicates shared genetic predisposition between ADHD, even if their underlying etiologies have not yet been fully explained. The use of data augmentation (DA), which can result in a quicker convergence to solution and improved prediction accuracy, is crucial to the success of CNN models. By using ADHD-200 Dataset and Different types of classification techniques, feature selection modules and fMRI images as input for early detection of ADHD.

articleTitle: Power Consumption Forecast for Load Management in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Amidst the dynamic landscape of contemporary energy management, this research delves into the pivotal challenge of power consumption forecasting, a linchpin for efficacious load management within the ambit of smart grids. Conventional power grids suffer from many problems like grid instability which results in power outages, voltage fluctuations, and even grid failures, overloading of transmission and distributed system, energy wastage etc. which are solved by smart grid solutions like two-way communication between the utility company and the consumer, automation and control which provides overall grid resilience, energy efficiency and integration of renewable energy.The core objective of this research is to confront the limitations inherent in conventional grids through the harnessing of forecasting techniques within a time series framework to address the pressing load management issues through the development and a comparative analysis of three distinct time series forecasting models: ARIMA, SARIMA, and LSTM. Moreover, the project lays the foundation for future enhancements, like the integration of more advanced machine learning techniques and time series models, and the incorporation of additional data sources. This research contributes to the ongoing evolution of smart grid technology, with far-reaching implications for energy management, renewable energy sources and sustainability in the modern world.

articleTitle: Detection of Plant Disease for Paddy Crop Using an Ensemble of CNNs
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Using a network of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), the research presents a novel method for paddy crop disease detection. To increase agricultural productivity and quality in the face of a growing global demand for food, accurate disease identification is essential. This proposes a method that uses a weighted voting mechanism to combine the predictive potential of multiple CNN architectures to improve disease categorization precision and robustness. Extensive testing on a large dataset demonstrates that the ensemble CNNs outperform both the individual CNNs and the current best practices. Not only does the ensemble technique increase the accuracy of disease diagnosis, but it also demonstrates remarkable stability in the face of variations in image quality and disease symptoms. Our research contributes to the development of precision agricultural operations and the promotion of sustainable crop management through the efficient application of CNN ensembles. In order to ensure the safety of the world's food supply, it is necessary to improve current methods of disease detection and prevention, according to the findings of this study employing deep learning techniques.

articleTitle: Quantum Enhanced Support Vector Machine with Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial Encoding for Improved Cyclone Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: The paradigm of classical machine learning has been greatly revolutionized by the integration of the quantum computing paradigm, which has made it possible to solve complicated issues that were previously unsolvable by conventional computers. One such problem is accurately classifying cyclones with minimal data samples and feature parameters. In this paper, we investigate the superior learning capabilities of the Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial Embedding-based kernel Support Vector Machine classifier when compared to the classical Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier, especially in scenarios with less sample size and feature vector size. Surprisingly, our outcomes reveal that the quantum kernel strategy outperforms its traditional counterpart, even with a smaller sample-based dataset. This incredible performance can be attributed to the quantum core strategy’s exceptional ability to extract complex attributes, which enables it to extract more relevant insights from a smaller number of data points. We present a Quantum Kernel Support Vector Machine (QKSVM) built as a Quantum Kernel Circuit (QKC) in three configurations with varied qubit counts utilizing distinct embedding techniques: Angle embedding (QKSVM Angle), Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial embedding (QKSVM IQP), and Quantum Approximation Optimization Algorithm (QKSVM QAOA) embedding. Our results demonstrate that the QKSVM approach surpasses traditional SVM, especially when IQP embedding is employed. The QSVM model trained with four Principal Component Analysis (PCA) based selected relevant features outperforms the other QKC variations in cyclone classification, obtaining an excellent test accuracy rate of 91.66%.

articleTitle: Cloudburst Prediction in India Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Cloudbursts pose a significant threat in India, especially during the South-West Monsoon season that commences in June. India's diverse climate regions, including the northern Himalayan region, Indo-Gangetic Plain, southern peninsula, and coastal areas, experience sporadic cloudbursts, with only 31 recorded instances, mainly in Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, and Jammu and Kashmir. To address the lack of comprehensive Indian cloudburst data, we've curated a dataset, incorporating meteorological factors for cloudburst prediction. This dataset encompasses variables such as Temperature, Wind Gust, Wind Gust Speed, Humidity, Monsoon patterns, Air Pressure, and Cloud Density. Our goal is to improve preparedness and mitigation strategies, safeguarding lives, and property in cloudburst-prone areas. Employing optimized machine learning algorithms, our model analyzes these parameters alongside prevailing weather conditions, facilitating cloudburst event prediction. We evaluate the prediction performance of machine learning algorithms, including Random Forest, Cat Boost, XG Boost, and Decision Tree. The Cat Boost algorithm outperformed others with an accuracy of 86.18%. Moreover, we provide graphical insights into the correlation between humidity and cloudburst occurrence, emphasizing the importance of weather variables in prediction models. This research contributes to cloudburst forecasting, even with limited Indian data, and highlights the potential of utilizing diverse machine learning techniques for improved accuracy.

articleTitle: Real-time CCTV Footage Violence Detection with Alarm System using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: The increasing proliferation of surveillance cameras to keep an eye on human behavior has led to a rise in the need for an automated system that can identify violent incidents and suspicious activities. In smart buildings, this technology is mandatory. Violence Detection in real time will prevent any mishappenings from taking place by raising alerts to the security guards. Our model also has YOLO object detection inculcated in it in order to recognize any weapons or tools that an attacker may be using against people and the security guards will act accordingly.In this paper, we have utilized deep learning model and techniques to create a lightweight system for detecting violence that is fully automated and can act as an assistant for law enforcement officers, and can also be deployed in public areas as well as corporate buildings. When the system detects violence, it rings an alarm which can be used to alert security personals that some commotion may be happening in certain area.

articleTitle: Efficient Regular Expression Matching and Hardware-Accelerated Finite Automata Pattern Recognition in NIDS
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: To protect network infrastructure from the ever-changing cyber threats, Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) perform important duties. This study introduces a sophisticated algorithm aimed at overcoming key challenges in IDS. These challenges include efficient regular expression matching, hardware implementation, and improved pattern recognition. The algorithm employs a unique technique to reduce memory specifications by using controlled faults into the pattern matching process. It builds upon perfect hashing, ensuring precise and efficient regular expression matching, making it ideal for high-speed processing in IDS applications. Additionally, the central component of a hardware-based Network Intrusion Detection System (NIDS), the technique comprises a signature match processor that is based on a field-programmable gate array (FPGA). For effective string matching, this processor makes use of a CAM-based cellular architecture. For multiple signature matches, it generates priority-encoded addresses using a binary tree structure. To enhance IDS capabilities further, the algorithm introduces an efficient method for detecting regular expression matches within network traffic text using Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs). It presents a hardware implementation approach based on Deterministic Finite Automata (DFA), enhancing both speed and accuracy in pattern matching. This proposed algorithm provides a comprehensive solution to optimize intrusion detection by integrating innovative techniques in regular expression matching, hardware acceleration, and pattern recognition, thereby enhancing network security against springing cyber threats.

articleTitle: Automated Printed Circuit Board Inspection: Incorporating YOLOv8 for Efficient Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: In the realm of modern electronics, Printed Circuit Boards (PCBs) serve as fundamental components, facilitating the seamless integration of circuits across a wide spectrum of applications, from smartphones to space exploration. However, addressing the formidable challenge of efficiently detecting concealed threats within complex environments, where they frequently camouflage themselves within the background, has become a serious threat. To tackle this intricate challenge, the implementation of an Automatic Visual Inspection (AVI) system emerges as an indispensable necessity in today’s world. The objective of this research is to create a proficient system for detecting defects in printed circuit boards (PCBs) by employing YOLOv8, the most recent advancement in the YOLO series of object detection models. Our model has achieved a mean Average Precision (mAP50) of 0.955 and (mAP50-95) of 0.516, ensuring the robust detection of PCB defects. Experimental results have revealed that this model exhibits enhanced detection accuracy in comparison to conventional and deep learning object detection models. To assess the performance of this model a comparison with the previous iteration, YOLOv7 with the same experimentation scenarios was conducted. The results demonstrated that the Yolov8 had 17% increment in the mAP50 metric.

articleTitle: The Big Data Analytics and its Effectiveness on Bank Financial Risk Management
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to gain an understanding of the applications and uses of big data analytics in banking operations as well as the opinions of banking employees regarding the usage of big data analytics to investigate financial crimes. The creation of a great volume of information coming from a variety of channels is a consequence of people being willing to take risks and exchange personal information with one another. This is indicative of the growing plethora of information coming from a multitude of sources, which is a characteristic of the banking industry.The structural questionnaire was employed as a research instrument, and the cross-sectional survey method was used to collect data from 180 banking workers in Bangalore who deal with IT-related job. The study was carried out between the months of July and September 2023, with the convenience sampling method being utilized to pick samples, and descriptive statistics being utilized to carry out analyses on the collected data. The research ultimately arrives to the conclusion that big data analytics is the trend that is advancing at the quickest rate. It is useful for the banks in the management of vast amounts of data. has conducted research into significant problems facing banks that are connected to big data, such as risk assessment, management of creditworthiness, customer assessment, bankruptcy forecasting, prevention of counterfeiting, program plan authority, funding, financial gain, and competitiveness.

articleTitle: CNN based Human Intention-Behavior Prediction using Common Average Reference and STFT of EEG Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: A newly emerging research field is application of brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), for human intention-behavior prediction. In order to improve brain wave intention recognition, recent studies have included pretrained convolution neural networks (CNN). In this research, the pretrained ResNet50 model is fine-tuned using a transfer learning strategy. We first enhance the EEG signals using the common average reference (CAR) approach. Further, we compute short time Fourier transform (STFT) and obtain the spectrogram. Moreover, we combine mu and beta band images extracted from spectrogram. The combined mu and beta band images are given as the input to the pretrained ResNet50 model. The following work, we divided BCI competition-IV dataset-2b data into three ratios of training: validation: test in 6:2:2, 7:1:2, and 8:1:1. Then we performed classification using pretrained ResNet50 which resulting in classification accuracies of 91.22%, 94.42%, and 94.14%. The efficiency of the suggested model is compared with the existing models.

articleTitle: PaF & MbOTS: Novel Task Scheduling Strategies for Fog Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Task scheduling in cloud-fog architectures is a critical concern, necessitating prioritising latency-sensitive tasks with efficient resource utilization in order to enhance quality metrics. Effective task scheduling in the fog environment is crucial for mitigating issue of elongated response time and execution delay. The paper delves into these mentioned complexities of task scheduling by proposing a optimal schemes for efficient allocation of latency-sentive tasks to capable fog nodes in the fog environment. The work introduced two novel algorithms; Firstly, Promotion as Fog (PaF) method promoting volunteer end nodes to fog nodes considering their static and dynamic state. Secondly, Matrix-based Optimal Task Scheduling (MbOTS) method prioritizing tasks based on specific parameters for optimal scheduling. The proposed work is implemented and validated which demonstrates its efficiency in terms of reducing total execution time with an average improvement of 15.12 %, reducing total waiting time with 14.3%, and execution delay with 2% as compared to existing methods.

articleTitle: Decision Support System for Early Prediction of Sepsis
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Sepsis, an unusual immune system response to an infection is a life-threatening condition. An early detection of such a condition can result in saving about 20% of patients from mortality. This paper illustrates a new approach to detecting sepsis which is based on not only the data collected from the existing cases but also contains the essence of the traditional definitions used by the doctors for sepsis detection. A rule-based clinical support system has been proposed which is an amalgamation of the Artificial Intelligence (AI) models and the standard definition for detecting sepsis worldwide. The paper presents an overview of the traditional decision-making process for correctly predicting sepsis at an early stage using the rule-based approach. The dataset used is a labeled dataset from Kaggle for sepsis prediction titled "Prediction of Sepsis" provided by PhysioNet Computing in Cardiology Challenge in 2019. The amalgamation of these two would surely enhance the prediction models used for sepsis detection and facilitate its early detection making it life-saving for the patients.

articleTitle: Object based Change detection on Temporal Multi-Spectral Satellite imagery
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Monitoring changes in multi-spectral satellite images is important for tracking urbanization and environmental changes that happened on the earth. This study mainly focuses on usage of multi-spectral satellite images to identify the environmental changes such as natural world transformation. The proposed method in this study uses FCNN Algorithm and also LandTrendr for change detection with respect to Time Series data. Two distinct methods are used in this study to identify the changes in temporal and non-temporal data, respectively. The system's ability to identify changes in a variety of environments and landscapes is being assessed using evaluation metrics like accuracy, precision, and recall. The examined approach was evaluated over numerous satellite images and it was successful. This research makes it simpler to understand the changes in satellite images, which is very helpful for applications like city planning and environmental protection. This research offers a flexible framework that is useful for land use assessment, disaster management and urban planning. A useful method for monitoring dynamic environments, FCNN’s integration with object-based and pixel-based analysis improves the accuracy and usefulness of change detection. The LandTrendr algorithm gives complete changes with indexes like NDVI, NBI, etc. and it make use of Time series data (Temporal) in order to represent changed counts in the form a graph and measuring performance with Accuracy measure.

articleTitle: An Effective Cervical Cancer Detection Approaches - A Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: The chance to preserve a life is provided by early identification of cervical cancer, which is the fourth most common malignancy among women globally. Early diagnosis can lower its frequency. However, due to a number of variables, manual screening techniques are ineffective in detecting cervical cancer. However, this leads to incorrect diagnoses and excessive therapy. Therefore, researchers suggested cervical identification using both conventional and deep learning (DL) methods. This study examines future approaches for automated cervical cancer diagnosis and reviews prior work, focusing on the DL area. This is thought to ensure accurate diagnosis and may possibly lower the incidence of cervical cancer. The comparison chart is provided among various techniques in which EL-SVM model shows higher accuracy.

articleTitle: MRI-CT Fusion Based on Phase Congruency of Intrinsic Functions and Laplacian of Residuals
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Multi-modality image fusion has become a valuable method in different fields like remote sensing, video surveillance and medical diagnosis. The study introduces an innovative approach for fusing multi-modality medical images using Phase Congruency and Local Laplacian Energy. Through this technique, we employ empirical mode decomposition to separate the input images into intrinsic and residual components. Intrinsic are combined by PC-based fusion rule to enhance fine details for medical diagnosis. For the residue components, we used the Local Laplacian Energy, which encompasses Weighted Local Energy and weighted sum of eight-neighborhood based modified Laplacian to capture structured and texture features from input. Consequently, this fusion rule integrates both key components of image. The fused intrinsic and residual components are transformed inversely to obtain final output fused image. Our approach demonstrates good performance in terms of image quality and also computational efficiency for the input images.

articleTitle: The development of a self-help respiratory ailment mobile application
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: In the wake of COVID, healthcare took a new perspective. People are now more concerned about their health and the possible effects of different diseases than ever before. But informal communication channels and unverified information circulating all around has increased the circumstances where people are relying more than these or first on these than on certified medical professionals. It has never been more important to integrate the overall healthcare resources such that people are no longer afraid and no longer must look for other avenues for medical guidance.Through this report, it is intended to propose an application that combines the traditional healthcare offering with modern features that enable 24x7 care without creating burden on the existing healthcare infrastructure. It can be considered as a way of optimizing healthcare for a wider and more cost-effective reach while giving patients a greater control over their health and wellbeing.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement to Improve Accuracy for the Identification of Lyme Disease by using Novel ANN Algorithm by Comparing with K-Mean Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: The goal of this study is to evaluate the accuracy of novel Artificial Neural Network (ANN) machine learning models to the K-mean method in identifying Lyme disease in humans. Materials and Methods: The two groups in the research are the novel ANN machine learning model and the K-mean method. The dataset utilized in this study is a sample set of 889 photos from Kaggle that was used to identify Lyme infection. Training and test datasets were built from the dataset. With a G power of 80%, accuracy was estimated using a training dataset of 716 images and a test dataset of 173 images. The experiment was iterated 20 times using the mentioned models. Results and Discussion: For the dataset on Lyme disease, it was shown that the novel ANN model achieved an accuracy of 89% compared to the K-mean algorithm’s 87%. It is obvious that the novel Artificial Neural Network is shown to have superior statistical significance than the K-mean model, with a p value of 0.001, which is less than 0.05 in the independent t-test. The findings indicate that the novel Artificial Neural Network approach is beneficial for early Lyme disease prediction and successful at recognizing skin lesions.

articleTitle: Methane Gas Prediction Model in Underground Coalmines: A Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: The environment of underground coal mines (UCMs) is susceptible to many environmental problems and consequential hazard. Among those problems, mine fire is a liable threat that causes the loss of lives of mine workers and other valuable infrastructure and resources in the mines. Moreover, methane gas concentration in the mine area is one of the major causes of fire explosion. Therefore, continuous monitoring is very important for prediction of methane gas in UCMs. Internet of Things (IoT), nowadays, is widely utilized for continuous monitoring of the environment of UCMs. For the purpose of monitoring, deploy sensor nodes in the region of UCMs to sense the environmental conditions and transfer the information to base station for further process. As the monitoring data are estimated and indistinct in nature, it is necessary to consider the data for taking precautions. In this paper, we propose a method to predict the methane concentration in UCMs by using multilayer perceptron. The multilayer perceptron model applied on the dataset sequentially to train the model by dividing the dataset into training and testing datasets. The training dataset is utilized to train a model. On the other hand, the testing dataset is utilized to evaluate the trained model. The overall process is implemented at the sink instead of control stations. In case of any hazardous situation, the sink takes immediate and necessary actions based on the sensed data rather than the control station. The trained model is simulated using WEKA tool for the data of continuous monitoring on different hazard conditions. This model is more reliable and works effectively when compared to other existing models in any kind of hazards situations in UCMs. The simulated results show the accuracy of proposed model outperforms the existing models.

articleTitle: Alcohol Detection, Facial Recognition and Gesture Enabled Multimedia Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: The Alcohol Detection, Facial Recognition and Gesture Enabled Multimedia Control System is a technology that can be integrated in vehicles which implements safe driving practices by alcohol detection using sensors. This system also allows the driver to control the vehicle's cabin temperature and multimedia control through hand gestures, minimizing distractions while driving. The system incorporates facial recognition to detect drowsiness of the driver and prevent the vehicle from starting, reducing the threat of accidents caused by driver fatigue. Proposed system also acts as an anti-theft system which scans the driver’s face to check if the person is authenticated to drive the vehicle. Proposed system discusses the system's architecture, implementation process, implicit advantages and features and test results, demonstrating its effectiveness in enhancing driving safety and comfort. The solution to support UNSD Goal - 3.6 & 11.2, resulting in estimated 14 % increase, in India’s GDP

articleTitle: AES+: A Modified AES Encryption with Enhanced Key Management and Distribution
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Cryptography serves as the cornerstone of data security, playing a vital role in safeguarding information during transmission and storage. This science employs various encryption techniques to render data unintelligible unless decrypted back to its original form. The efficacy of data security hinges on the encryption technique employed, with the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) being one of the most reliable techniques. AES, a symmetric block cypher, uses keys that are 128 bits, 192 bits, or 256 bits in length. However, when the provided key differs in length from the required key, the process of either padding or trimming is applied, inevitably leading to the loss of key-related data. This research paper seeks to address this challenge by exploring methods to preserve the integrity of the encryption key while enhancing the strength and reliability of AES encryption. By using a cyclic key-building transformation, this study aims to fortify data security protocols by enhancing heavy encryption and contributing to the advancement of cryptographic practices.

articleTitle: An Energy and Coverage-aware Optimal Routing Algorithm for Mobile Sink to Maximize Network Lifetime for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Due to dynamic changes in the environment of underground coal mine (UCM), the mining area has become hazarodous that set down the miner lives in to high risk. Therefore, there is a need of continuous monitoring the of the environment. With this motivation, we implement wireless sensor networks (WSN) within the coal mine region, to maximize UCM coverage. Moreover, due to the limitation of small battery of the sensor in WSNs, there is a research gap in addressing the problems of network lifetime. In this paper, we propose a method to solve the coverage area and network lifetime problems.Results of a comparison between the proposed work and an existing algorithm indicate that the proposed algorithm outperforms the existing algorithm.

articleTitle: Empowering Women’s Safety: An Innovative Smart Security System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: In recent times, women’s personal security has become a sensitive issue around the world, particularly in India. Women and even small children and elderly people need protection from abusive activities such as kidnapping, rape, and chain snatching. However, in order to support their families financially, many women are required to work outside the home, often late into the night. Unfortunately, harassment and rape cases are increasing rapidly, making it essential for women to have safe working environments as well as safe surroundings outside of work. To address this issue, a portable security system has been proposed that utilizes sensors in shoes triggered by the wearer’s movements. Off-the-shelf electronic devices are used in this system, with corresponding actions carried out based on the pressure applied to the foot. The proposed system also includes a database backend for cross-referencing and validation purposes.

articleTitle: Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning for Brain MRI Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Advancements in medical imaging facilities have led to a substantial increase in the generation of medical imaging data on a daily basis. This creates an excellent opportunity for researchers to develop data-driven methods to improve healthcare. However, one of the major challenges in this regard is the requirement of large, diverse, and high-quality datasets for effective training, which are often scarce within a single institution. Although combining datasets from multiple institutions into a central repository would be ideal, data privacy regulations pose significant obstacles, particularly when involving institutions from different countries. To address this issue, Federated Learning (FL) can be employed, enabling the training of machine learning models on distributed data from various sites. In this research, federated learning has been employed for Brain MRI Analysis and to assess the generalizability of the models using data from institutions outside the federation. The distributed architecture of FL, however, introduces a vulnerability to adversarial users who may manipulate the global model by modifying their local updates or datasets. To overcome this challenge, FedByz aggregation algorithm has been proposed, which enhances the resilience of FL against Byzantine users. The experiments demonstrate that this approach achieves convergence even in the presence of Byzantine users, and its accuracy is comparable to that of traditional federated learning benchmarks.

articleTitle: Financial Portfolio Optimization: A QAOA and VQE Formulation for Sharpe Ratio Maximization
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: A quantum approach for portfolio optimization involves using quantum computing to solve complex optimization problems related to portfolio selection. The approach involves constructing a mathematical model of the portfolio optimization problem using various algorithms such as the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) or the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE). This approach has the potential to provide more accurate and efficient solutions than classical approaches, particularly for large and complex portfolio optimization problems. Moreover, this paper also dives into discussing and comparing the results obtained from both these approaches. Our work is under the assumptions required for the proposed formulation deriving meaningful considerations about the solution quality found, measured as the value of Sharpe Ratio.

articleTitle: Analyzing Deep Reinforcement Learning Strategies for Enhanced Profit Generation and Risk Mitigation in Algorithm Stock Trading
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Recent Trends in Advance Computing (ICRTAC)
abstract: Stock trading holds a pivotal role for investors seeking to navigate the intricate world of financial markets with the dual objectives of maximizing profits and minimizing risks. Algorithmic trading, driven by Deep Reinforcement Learning, has emerged as a pivotal tool for automating trading operations. However, the dynamic and often turbulent nature of financial data poses formidable challenges to maintaining consistent performance. Formulating profitable trading strategies in such an environment remains an ongoing and substantial challenge. In response to these challenges, our research endeavors to establish an efficient stock trading system by harnessing the predictive prowess of Deep Q-Networks (DQN). Our DQN-based model has showcased outstanding performance, achieving a remarkable reward score of 1.125, thereby reinforcing its reputation for reliability and resilience in the stock trading domain.
